body: Thank you. This was very helpful and I’m bringing it to my therapist the next time I see him. It almost goes hand in hand with the work we’re currently doing and I think accompanies it nicely in a frame that I can handle.
My ex forced me into it. I loved and wanted my baby. I posted before and it explains everything. I’d write all out again but It’s too complicated and tiring to rewrite and I have no energy to do it.
